name: tutor_review
description: Administrator-controlled test-only tutor review data, kept private from learners and tutors

profile_id.description: Tutor application identifier this demo review belongs to

tutor_email.description: Private tutor owner email used only for server validation

stars.description: Administrator-entered demo review stars from 1 to 5

is_test_review.description: Identifies this as an administrator-created demo review, not a completed lesson review

is_visible.description: Whether the administrator includes this demo review in the public snapshot

demo_lesson_reference.description: Unique synthetic reference for a test review; does not represent a real lesson
